portal_description:
OVN, the Open Virtual Network, is a system to support virtual network abstraction.  OVN complements the existing capabilities of OVS to add native support for virtual network abstractions, such as virtual L2 and L3 overlays and security groups.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* OVN: support activation strategy for multi-chassis port bindings that would activate port on GARP or NA in addition to RARP (JIRA:FDP-1042)

* [CI] Add test for TR hairpin conditional NAT (JIRA:FDP-1077)

* Live-migration: issue pinging migrated port from container port on src node (JIRA:FDP-1223)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - ovn-controller should re-ARP for MAC binding entries that are in active use but about to expire (JIRA:FDP-1230)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - no --template option for lb-add in manpage of ovn-nbctl (JIRA:FDP-1275)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - Failure to reconcile duplicate SB Load Balancer entries (JIRA:FDP-1366)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - Flapping OCP virtual ports (JIRA:FDP-1368)

* [EVPN] Add support for remote VTEP learning for Logical Switches and Logical Routers. (JIRA:FDP-1385)

* [EVPN] Add support for FDB learning through L2 EVPN. (JIRA:FDP-1387)

* [EVPN] Add support for OVN FDB advertisements through L2 EVPN. (JIRA:FDP-1389)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - Multi-tier ACL chains that end with action "pass" don't commit to conntrack. (JIRA:FDP-1393)

* Log exact change that caused I-P recompute (JIRA:FDP-1396)

* [EVPN] Add (OVS/OVN) library support for monitoring and interacting with Linux neighbor (fdb/arp/nd) tables. (JIRA:FDP-1416)

* Make OVN more robust to OVS BFD failures when running in HA mode (JIRA:FDP-1418)

* OVN: netlink failures not handled in route-exchange codebase  (JIRA:FDP-1440)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - ovn doesn't properly advertise neighbor router NAT/LBs for directly connected (peer) routers (JIRA:FDP-1451)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - ovn-northd incremental processing - handle ACL creation/deletion (JIRA:FDP-1460)

* [ovn-nbctl] Enhance acl-list <LS> to also display ACLs applied through port groups. (JIRA:FDP-1462)

* [ovn-nbctl] Add a pg-list command to list port group contents in a human friendly interface. (JIRA:FDP-1463)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - BW limit not applied to VM with VLAN port whose compute's NIC has type=system (JIRA:FDP-1487)

* Add incremental processing for en_datapath_logical_switch (JIRA:FDP-1519)

* Add incremental processing for en-datapath-synced-logical-switch (JIRA:FDP-1522)

* Add incremental processing for en-datapath-synced-logical-router (JIRA:FDP-1523)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - OVN routers cause exact match on IPv6 external addresses in OVS datapath (JIRA:FDP-1558)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - [OVN][BGP] Expose config to tweak whether distributed NAT IPs are advertised on all chassis. (JIRA:FDP-1576)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - bgp: connected-as-host redistributes nat entries too. (JIRA:FDP-1577)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - Packet Loss Between VMs on DPDK Compute Nodes  - Issue Persists Despite All Recommendations of KCS(7076184) Applied (JIRA:FDP-1582)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - Static MAC binding "referential integrity violation" (JIRA:FDP-1638)

* Issues due to datapath binding recreation when upgrading to 25.09 (JIRA:FDP-1650)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - BGP: connected-as-host redistribution requires an LRP with an IP (JIRA:FDP-1656)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - [OVN][BGP] ovn-controller modifies the host routing table while dumping its contents (JIRA:FDP-1677)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - DVR + VLAN Tenant Network + reside_on_redirect_chassis False . Connectivity issue to external network (JIRA:FDP-1720)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - ovn-nbctl --wait=sb returns too early (JIRA:FDP-1722)

* CLONE [ovn25.09 fast-datapath-rhel-9] - ping6 from floating ip to external would fail (JIRA:FDP-1745)

* OVN 25.09 OVN-25.9 RHEL 9 Release (JIRA:FDP-1769)

* possible packet loop in ovn multicast (JIRA:FDP-58)

* OVN incorrectly relies on conntrack to reassemble IP fragments (JIRA:FDP-684)

* OVN northd not handle binding request for a virtual port on single logical switch topology (JIRA:FDP-710)

* ovn-northd incremental processing - handle port group <-> switch mapping changes (JIRA:FDP-758)

* Configure graceful restart for ovn-controller via ovsdb instead of --restart (JIRA:FDP-959)
